name: @effected/mcp

tools.name: identity
tools.description: Reports the effected tool's identity: the tool name, this server's version, the carrier distribution it was launched through (null for a direct install), and the resolved effect version.

tools.name: schema_check
tools.description: Checks the generated schema documents against the config, writing nothing. Drift and staleness arrive as the result's verdict, with each changed document's full diff; they are not errors. Reloads the config on every call.

config.description: The schemastore config, resolved against the workspace root and refused outside it. Omitted, discovery walks upward from the server's working directory, stopping at the workspace root.

drift.description: One drift tolerance over every schema's own.

force.description: Shorthand for drift "allow", and refused beside any other drift.

tools.name: schema_build
tools.description: Generates the schema documents and catalogs the config declares and writes the ones that changed, wherever the config puts them. A refused drift or a failed gate writes nothing and arrives as the result's verdict. Reloads the config on every call.

config.description: The schemastore config, resolved against the workspace root and refused outside it. Omitted, discovery walks upward from the server's working directory, stopping at the workspace root.

drift.description: One drift tolerance over every schema's own.

force.description: Shorthand for drift "allow", and refused beside any other drift.

tools.name: schema_validate
tools.description: Validates a JSON payload file against a local schema document, with each finding's line and column. A payload that does not conform is valid: false, not an error.

payload.description: The payload file, resolved against the workspace root and refused outside it.

config.description: The schemastore config, resolved against the workspace root and refused outside it. Omitted, discovery walks upward from the server's working directory, stopping at the workspace root.

schema.description: The document: a file path under the workspace root, or an $id or url the config derives. Omitted, the payload's own $schema.

tools.name: package_build
tools.description: Builds one package from its effected.toml into dist/prod: JS, declarations, the manifest, the API model and any binary. A build that crashes or records an error arrives as the result's verdict "failed" with its issues, not as an error. Reloads the config on every call.

cwd.description: The package directory, resolved against the workspace root and refused outside it. Omitted, the server's working directory.

noExe.description: Skip the single-executable compile; the manifest still points at the binary.

tools.name: action_build
tools.description: Builds one GitHub Action from the [action] table of its effected.toml into dist: validates the config and action.yml, bundles each entry into one file, and checks that each loads. It writes only dist unless persist is true, which also copies the build to .github/actions/local and generates .actrc and .github/workflows/act-test.yml. Validation stopping the build or an entry failing arrives as the result's verdict "failed", not as an error. Reloads the config on every call. The load check imports each bundle, which runs an action with no GITHUB_ACTIONS guard unless [action.build] importCheck is false.

cwd.description: The action's directory, resolved against the workspace root and refused outside it. Omitted, the server's working directory.

validate.description: Validate first and check bundle sizes after. Omitted, true.

persist.description: Copy the build to .github/actions/local and generate .actrc and .github/workflows/act-test.yml when they are absent, unless the config disables it. Omitted, false.

tools.name: action_init
tools.description: Scaffolds a new GitHub Action in a package directory: the [action] table of effected.toml, action.yml, src/main.ts, src/program.ts and tsconfig.json, to the kit's canonical shape, ready for action_build. It refuses, writing nothing, when any of those files exists, unless force is true, and always when a path it writes is a symbolic link or the wrong kind of entry: it never follows a link and never writes outside cwd. It edits no package.json: the result names the dependencies to add and whether the package is type module.

cwd.description: The package directory, resolved against the workspace root and refused outside it. Omitted, the server's working directory.

name.description: The action's display name in action.yml. Omitted, package.json's name without its scope.

description.description: What the action does, for action.yml. Omitted, package.json's description.

force.description: Replace files that already exist. Omitted, false.

instructions: effected-mcp serves the effected tool. Call identity to learn the tool name, this server's version, the distribution it was launched through and the resolved effect version. schema_check reports whether the generated schema documents match the config and writes nothing, schema_build writes them, and schema_validate checks a JSON payload against one. Drift, staleness and a failed validation arrive as results (a verdict, or valid: false), not as errors; an error means the config could not be found or loaded, a path was outside the workspace root, or the run could not finish. Each call reloads the config and the TypeScript and JSON it imports, but an imported .mjs, .cjs or built .js under type: module stays cached, so restart this server after rebuilding a sibling package the config uses. package_build builds one package into its dist/prod; a build that crashes or records an error arrives as the verdict failed with its issues, not as an error, and an error means the effected.toml or a plugin would not load, the directory is not a package, or it was outside the workspace root. action_build builds one GitHub Action from the [action] table of its effected.toml into its dist; validation stopping the build or an entry failing to bundle or load arrives as the verdict failed with what it found, not as an error, and an error means the effected.toml would not load, it has no [action] table, the directory is not a package or is outside the workspace root, or a file could not be written. It writes only dist unless persist is true, which also writes .github/actions/local, .actrc and .github/workflows/act-test.yml. Unless [action.build] importCheck is false, it imports each bundle to prove it loads, which runs an action with no GITHUB_ACTIONS guard around its program. action_init scaffolds a new action in a package directory (effected.toml's [action] table, action.yml, src/main.ts, src/program.ts, tsconfig.json) ready for action_build; it refuses, writing nothing, when any of those files exists unless force is true, and always when one is a symbolic link or the wrong kind of entry, and it edits no package.json, naming the dependencies to add instead.
